content: Even though classic RvNNs have demonstrated superior performance on a variety of tasks, their inflexibility, i.e. their inability to handle dynamic compositionality for different syntactic configurations, is a considerable weakness. For instance, it would be desirable if our model could distinguish e.g. adjective-noun composition from that of verb-noun or preposition-noun composition, as models failing to make such a distinction ignore real-world syntactic considerations such as `-arity' of function words (i.e. types), and the adjunct/argument distinction.
